text:
Shaquille O’Neal to perform pregame concert for UVA students before football opener
P. V. Crane
NBA Hall of Famer Shaquille O’Neal, performing as DJ Diesel, will hold a concert at Observatory Hill for University of Virginia students prior to the Virginia football season opener against NC State on Aug. 29, according to an Aug. 19 announcement.
The free event is open exclusively to UVA students and will begin at 1 p.m., following ACC Huddle from 10 a.m. to noon on the green space at the base of Observatory Hill, located at the corner of McCormick and Alderman Road. Students must present their NC State game ticket for admission. Additional logistical details are expected next week.
O’Neal has performed internationally under his DJ Diesel persona since debuting in dance music at TomorrowWorld in 2015. He mixes Trap, EDM, and Hip-Hop and has recently completed a ‘Summer of SHAQ' tour with over 15 dates. His performances have included appearances at The Sphere in Las Vegas, Tomorrowland in Belgium, Lost Lands in Ohio, Life in Color in Miami, and his own festival series called Shaq's Fun House.
For fans attending games this season, Virginia Athletics is offering several ticket packages including discounted four-pack options for single games or families, and special pricing for faculty, staff, young alumni within five years of graduation, and contributing members of the Alumni Association. Season-ticket renewals are also available starting at $180 per seat.
Virginia Athletics has transitioned all permit-required parking areas serving home football games to digital parking passes accessible through online accounts or the Virginia Sports mobile app. Public parking lots that do not require permits remain unchanged.
